commit_message: Add ADR 0144 AI Studio visual scenario
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0144 hosted model backends
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR 0144 hosted and enterprise ModelBackend support behind the existing native AI Studio harness. Adds OS-protected machine-local credential ownership, explicit NetworkAccess approval, structured provider failure mapping, honest capability reporting, backend/remote-processing UI, sanitized Remote AI Studio posture, and preserves Agent Host completion ownership. Adds a validation-only deterministic AI Studio startup scenario so the changed backend and credential UI can be captured and reviewed.

## Validation

Requires Windows Validation and Editor Visual Validation because backend and credential selection UI changes.
